title: What's New — Deeper Hardware Diagnostics + Automatic OEM Drivers
summary: Hardware diagnostics now exercise PulseGuard-owned audio/video paths with FPS and explicit CPU-temperature gating, while the driver engine can discover exact OEM driver packages dynamically instead of requiring a hard-coded motherboard rule.

items.heading: PulseGuard-owned sound + video tests
items.detail: The 3-minute stability test now generates its own stereo audio and uses a bundled 720p60 H.264 video playback window with presentation FPS, resolution and stall metrics instead of depending on the optional Windows WinSAT sample video.

items.heading: CPU temperature is explicit
items.detail: Temperature results now distinguish CPU, GPU and storage telemetry. A GPU or SSD temperature can no longer make the Temperature lane PASS when an actual CPU sensor is unavailable.

items.heading: Dynamic motherboard driver discovery
items.detail: Normal motherboard/device drivers can be discovered from exact official OEM support sources, validated against live hardware and signed INF metadata, then downloaded and installed automatically. BIOS flashing remains manual.
